description: This is a test source file for ViewModels in an Android note organizer app, testing ViewModel behaviors like filtering notes, creating, editing, and deleting notes using coroutines and LiveData.

classes.name: ViewModelsTest
classes.description: Test class for various ViewModel behaviors in the note organizer app.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes in-memory database, repository, and API before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the database after each test.

methods.name: notesListViewModel_setQuery_filters_results_reactively
methods.description: Tests that setting a query filters notes reactively in the NotesListViewModel.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_create_trims_input_and_persists_note
methods.description: Tests creation of a note with input trimming and persistence.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_edit_updates_existing_note_and_uiState_emits_note
methods.description: Tests editing an existing note and the emission of the updated UI state.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_delete_removes_note_and_calls_onDone
methods.description: Tests deleting a note and invoking the callback.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_delete_when_creating_is_noop_and_onDone_called
methods.description: Ensures delete is a no-op when the note does not exist and onDone is called.

methods.name: noteEditorViewModel_with_missing_noteId_emits_null_note
methods.description: Verifies that a missing noteId leads to emitting a null note in UI state.
